set.ref.prompt:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the young woman in <Picture 1>, <Picture 2> and <Picture 3>: a short dark chin-length bob, a long vermilion-orange tunic with full puffed sleeves, a deep indigo hooded cloak worn open over her shoulders and falling to her ankles, and dark boots. She moves slowly and carefully, with a calm, curious posture.
<Subject 2> is her double, the small figure standing beside the far wall in <Picture 3>: the same dark bob, vermilion-orange tunic and indigo cloak as <Subject 1>.
<Subject 3> is the rendering style of <Picture 1>, <Picture 2> and <Picture 3>: gouache and watercolor storybook illustration on grainy paper, flat layered shapes, teal and indigo night tones against warm cream and sepia, vermilion as the accent colour, white doves and floating golden orbs as soft glowing dabs.
<Picture 1> is the first frame of [Shot 1], showing <Subject 1> from behind with her raised hand on the bronze-stone rim of a huge round window in a stained cream plaster wall, the window opening onto a moonlit night forest with white doves.
<Picture 2> is a keyframe inside [Shot 1] at 00:05.500, after the camera has followed <Subject 1> through the window: she walks right in profile along a mossy forest path under the full moon, white doves flying low beside her, the round window glowing among the trees at upper left.
<Picture 3> is the keyframe of [Shot 2] at 00:09.500, showing <Subject 1> from behind in the right foreground at the edge of a black pond, looking across it at <Subject 2> standing beside a fragment of sunlit plaster wall with a round window.

summary:
[keyframe completion + reference generation] A fifteen-second 16:9 storybook sequence in <Subject 3> built as two flowing shots: one continuous camera move that follows <Subject 1> through the round window of <Picture 1> into the night forest and alongside her on the path through <Picture 2>, then a wipe made by a passing dove into <Picture 3>, where she finds <Subject 2>, her double, across a pond.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2]): fully_preserved - the same dark bob, vermilion tunic with full sleeves, indigo hooded cloak and dark boots throughout.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 2]): fully_preserved - hair and clothing identical to <Subject 1>.
<Subject 3> (applies to every shot): fully_preserved - the grainy paper texture, flat gouache shapes and the teal, indigo, cream and vermilion palette.
<Picture 1> ([Shot 1] first frame): fully_preserved - the round window on the left, her raised hand on its rim and the warm stained wall.
<Picture 2> ([Shot 1] keyframe at 00:05.500): fully_preserved - her profile walking right, the doves on the left, the moon and the glowing window among the trees.
<Picture 3> ([Shot 2] keyframe at 00:09.500): fully_preserved - her back in the right foreground, the black pond with the moon's reflection, the wading doves and golden orbs, and <Subject 2> at the lit wall across the water.

detailed_description:
The target video is a hand-painted storybook animation in <Subject 3>, built as one long flowing camera move and a single soft transition with no abrupt changes: shapes stay flat and painterly while they move, warm cream daylight against cool teal and indigo night.
[Shot 1] The shot begins from <Picture 1>. In the warm late-afternoon courtyard, <Subject 1> stands with her back to the camera, her hand on the rim of the huge round window, where white doves wheel through the night forest beyond the glass. She presses her palm flat to the glass and it ripples outward like water. She steps up and through it, her indigo cloak trailing behind her as the rippling surface closes around her. The camera follows her in one unbroken movement, pushing in with large amplitude at slow speed through the rippling glass; the warm courtyard light falls away behind as the frame fills with teal night forest. On the other side the path turns right, and the camera eases around to her left side and settles into a tracking shot at walking speed, so that at 00:05.500 the shot's keyframe corresponds to <Picture 2>: <Subject 1> in profile walking right along the mossy path, doves gliding low beside her, golden orbs drifting between the trunks, the round window she came through glowing small among the trees at the upper left. The camera keeps tracking with her as a dove beside her rises and banks toward the camera.
[Shot 2] At 00:09.000, the dove sweeps across the lens from left to right, its white wings filling the frame as a natural wipe, and the shot transitions to the pond; as the wing clears, the shot's keyframe at 00:09.500 corresponds to <Picture 3>. <Subject 1> stands at the edge of the still black pond, seen from behind in the right foreground, the moon's reflection shivering on the water while doves wade and golden orbs float. Across the pond, beside the fragment of sunlit plaster wall, <Subject 2> slowly turns her head to look across the water at <Subject 1> and lifts one hand. <Subject 1> goes still, then slowly raises her own hand in answer. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed over her shoulder toward <Subject 2> until the clip ends.

overall_soundscape:
A soft warm breeze moves through the courtyard while the crickets of the night forest are already faintly audible through the glass; the glass gives a low liquid shimmer as she passes through, and the crickets swell to full as the forest surrounds her. Footsteps press softly into moss, cloth rustles, and a dove's wings beat close to the camera through the wipe at 00:09.000. At the pond the crickets fall quiet and water laps gently around the wading doves.

non_diegetic_music:
One continuous kalimba line at about 60 BPM runs through the whole clip without a break; soft pizzicato strings enter as she passes through the glass and a low sustained cello joins on the forest path, swelling slightly into the wipe; after 00:09.500 the strings thin out and the kalimba slows, ending on one held note.
